responsibility: Declares the extra SH vendor-specific command-line options accepted by the SuperH embedded configuration, notably -mboard= and -mruntime=. These options are recognized here so the driver can pass them through to supplementary specs processing rather than handling them in the generic SH option table.
same_name_distinction: This file only declares the SuperH-specific driver options such as -mboard= and -mruntime= for supplementary specs handling, whereas superh.h performs the actual subtarget environment customization through spec, linker, startup, library, CPP, and assembler overrides.
